history.change: UI v3 (informatif, solid, compact): latar-app, ubin, hairline, track, batas-lembut, papan-hero, stabilo-soft, grafik-*, delta-*, avatar-1..5; radius kartu 20, ubin 14, kontrol 12; bayangan kartu, hero, aksi; teks isi 14, judul-kartu 16, mini 12, sumbu 11, angka-ubin 30, angka-hero 40.
Palet CMS: papan #1E5B4B, stabilo #F2C14E, kapur hangat, menu samping hijau tua.
